blocks.text: The Philippine peso drops to another record low on Wednesday. The drop to a new record level came as expectations of a more hawkish US Federal Reserve (Fed) bolstered the dollar, while investors awaited the next policy move of the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). The local currency shed 27.1 centavos from its previous finish to end the trading session at 63.361, data from the Bankers Association of the Philippines showed.
